youtube.title: Why Cat Eyes Glow in the Dark 🐱 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A cat's eyes seem to shine in the dark, but they produce no light of their own. Behind the retina sits a reflective layer called the tapetum lucidum. It bounces light that passed through the retina back a second time, giving photoreceptors another chance to catch it. This helps cats see in dim light and creates the glow when a beam hits their eyes.
